questions.question: Compare the following two addresses. Address 1: Ms. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres, Pune – 411045 Address 2: Mrs. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres Society, Pune – 411045 Are these likely to be the same?
questions.questionHtml:
Compare the following two addresses.
Address 1: Ms. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres, Pune – 411045
Address 2: Mrs. Neha Verma, Flat No. 204, Tower B, Green Acres Society, Pune – 411045
Are these likely to be the same?

options.text: No, the flat numbers are different
No, the name titles are different
No, city codes do not match

questions.solution:
Let’s compare the two addresses:

Flat No. 204, Tower B → ✅ Same in both

Green Acres vs. Green Acres Society → ✅ Likely the same residential complex; “ Society ” is often added informally

Pune – 411045 → ✅ Same city and PIN code

Ms. vs. Mrs. Neha Verma → ⚠️ Title differs, but name and flat details match

Despite the difference in title (Ms. vs. Mrs.), all major address details match.

✅ Correct answer: Yes, all major details match

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT option. Address 1: Mr. Rohit Sharma, 123/A, Rose Villa, Green Park, Delhi – 110016 Address 2: Mr. R. Sharma, 123-A, Rose Villa, Green Park, New Delhi – 110016 Are the two addresses likely to refer to the same person?
questions.questionHtml:
Choose the CORRECT option.

Address 1: Mr. Rohit Sharma, 123/A, Rose Villa, Green Park, Delhi – 110016

Address 2: Mr. R. Sharma, 123-A, Rose Villa, Green Park, New Delhi – 110016

Are the two addresses likely to refer to the same person?

options.text: Yes, both addresses are the same
No, the house numbers don’t match

questions.solution:
The two addresses contain the same house number (123/A = 123-A) , the same colony (Rose Villa, Green Park) , and the same pin code (110016) .
• The difference between “Delhi” and “New Delhi” is not significant in postal terms — both refer to the same metropolitan region.
• The difference in the names ("Rohit Sharma" vs "R. Sharma") is also acceptable as initials are often used in addresses.
• Therefore, both addresses are effectively the same and are highly likely to refer to the same person .

questions.question: Address A: Riya Kapoor, 7/2, Lake View Road, Kolkata – 700029 Address B: R. Kapoor, 7/2A, Lake View Rd, Kolkata – 700029 What is the most significant difference between the two addresses?
questions.questionHtml:
Address A: Riya Kapoor, 7/2, Lake View Road, Kolkata – 700029 Address B: R. Kapoor, 7/2A, Lake View Rd, Kolkata – 700029

What is the most significant difference between the two addresses?
questions.solution:
Step by Step:
• Both addresses are in the same city – Kolkata.
• Both addresses mention the same road – Lake View Road.
• Both addresses have the same surname – Kapoor.
• The only difference is in the house number : 7/2 vs 7/2A.

Correct Answer = Different house number
